Pattaya, Hua Hin, and Ayutthaya

These are not the first-week spine. Ayutthaya is the useful day trip. Hua Hin is a quieter gulf beach. Pattaya is a scene you should choose on purpose.

AyutthayaDay trip by train
Hua Hin3-4 hours south
PattayaOnly if you mean it
